tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Isomorphism of cellular and singular homology] ↗ prop:homology-cw-complexes ↗ lem:homology-cw-skeleton-pairs 1. ch2:2.35\group Cellular Homology

\[ H_n^{CW}(X)\cong H_n(X). \]
Proof

\sketch The maps $j_n$ identify $H_n(X^n)$ with $\ker \partial _n$ and carry $\operatorname {Im}\partial _{n+1}$ onto $\operatorname {Im}d_{n+1}$, yielding the quotient isomorphism.

□

For an $n$-cell $e_\alpha ^n$, the cellular boundary is \[ d_n(e_\alpha ^n)=\sum _\beta d_{\alpha \beta }e_\beta ^{n-1}, \] where $d_{\alpha \beta }$ is the degree of the attaching map $S^{n-1}\to X^{n-1}\to X^{n-1}/(X^{n-1}-e_\beta ^{n-1})\cong S^{n-1}$.
